Lottery Number Generator

Generate random lottery numbers with your own max number and count. Sorted lucky balls, optional duplicates, and a history of your draws.

Random for fun — lotteries can't be predicted. Every draw is independent.

Draw history

    No draws yet — your generated sets will appear here.

    📖 How to use

    1. Set the highest number (e.g. 49) and how many numbers to draw (e.g. 6).
    2. Keep “No duplicates” on for realistic lottery-style draws, or turn it off for repeats.
    3. Click “Generate” to draw your sorted lucky balls.
    4. Every draw is saved to the history list below, so you can compare sets.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    Can this predict winning lottery numbers?

    No — and nothing can. Every draw is independent and random, so these numbers are purely for fun.

    How random are the numbers?

    The tool uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) when available, falling back to Math.random.

    Why can't I draw 10 numbers from 1–9 without duplicates?

    With duplicates off, the count can't exceed the highest number — there simply aren't enough unique numbers to draw.
